keywords_en: EIP-8141 frame and signature entries priced at the floor
summary_en: pcaversaccio pointed to a new ChainSecurity article: EIP-8037 and EIP-8038 can force some contracts to upgrade just to restore their intended behavior, even with no bytecode changes. That set the stage for the next day's ACDE decision to postpone Hoodi. On the spec side, EIP-8141 prices frame and signature entries at the floor, EIP-8279 checks the floor against the execution gas budget, and the post-quantum validator key registry was merged as a draft.
